customer: Hello, I'm hoping to sell my midsize SUV, but I just got a notice that it has an open safety recall. Would you still be willing to buy it, and would the recall lower what you'd offer me? Thank you for your help.
agent: Thanks for reaching out! Yes, we do buy cars with open safety recalls, and an open recall doesn't change your offer. Recall repairs are free at a dealer for your SUV's brand, so you're welcome to have it fixed first if you'd like, but you don't have to. You can find more in our article "Selling a car with an open recall."
